title: Test a faulty sum
prompt: Write `catchesMissingLast(candidate): boolean`. A correct `candidate` sums an array of numbers. A broken one sums every item except the last. Call `candidate` on an input of your choice and return `true` if the result is right, `false` if it is wrong. Your input must tell the two versions apart.
hints: What do both versions return for `[]`?
Pick an input where the last item changes the sum.
Work out the expected sum yourself. Do not compute it with `candidate`.
checks: (() => { let calls = 0; catchesMissingLast(xs => { calls++; return 0; }); return calls > 0; })()

wrongAnswers.misconception: Always returns `true`, so it never catches the broken version.
Tests an empty array, where both versions return 0.

feedback: What do both versions return for `[]`?
